title: The Book of Nonsense
author: Edward Lear
description: "The Book of Nonsense" by Edward Lear is a whimsical collection of nonsensical poetry and verse written during the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This charming book is renowned for its playful use of language and absurd characters, representing a key example of Victorian literature that celebrates imagination and humor.

authorInfo.bio: Edward Lear (1812–1888) wrote The Book of Nonsense. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
